meta.name: compact-resume
meta.description: Post-compact pickup — read continuation handoff, verify state (tree clean, monitors alive, dispatch drift), resume next-action.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 恢复中断任务并验证系统状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在压缩操作后正确恢复工作流
copy.tagline_en: Resume interrupted tasks and verify system state
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to restore workflow after a compression operation

howto.what: 运行 /compact-resume 后，Claude 会读取 /compact-prepare 生成的交棒文件，检查工作树是否干净、监控是否存活、调度有无漂移，然后报告状态并给出下一步行动。
howto.when: 在刚执行完 /compact 之后使用。需要先运行 /compact-prepare，再运行 /compact，最后触发此技能。

say.note: 触发技能读取交棒文件并恢复状态。

say.text: 帮我检查压缩后的状态
say.note: 技能会报告树、监控、调度等信息。

howto.what_en: After /compact, /compact-resume reads the handoff written by /compact-prepare, verifies the working tree is clean, monitors are alive, and dispatches haven't drifted, then reports status and provides the next action.
howto.when_en: Use immediately after running /compact, when you previously ran /compact-prepare then /compact, and need to re-orient before resuming the task.

say_en.note: Triggers the skill to read handoff and verify state.
Skill reports tree, monitors, dispatches, and next action.
